svg.title: Intention-to-treat: analyse as randomised
svg.desc: One hundred people per arm. Twelve leave the drug arm and eight leave the placebo arm. Intention-to-treat still analyses one hundred against one hundred; per-protocol analyses eighty-eight against ninety-two.
svg.text: Drop-outs stay in their original arm, or randomisation breaks
Leaving out drop-outs flatters the drug: always check the intention-to-treat result.
